# Engineering Manager Interview

> The manager loop round by round: people management, project retrospective, behavioral, and system design for managers. A free guide from DesignGurus.io, in plain Markdown, with no account required.

Each page is short and ends with links to full course lessons and free articles. Each description below is the opening sentence of that page.

## Cheat sheets

- [A Four-Week Preparation Plan](https://github.com/design-gurus/engineering-manager-interview/blob/main/cheat-sheets/four-week-plan.md): This plan prepares a working manager for an engineering manager loop in four weeks, at about six hours a week.
- [Engineer and Manager Roles Compared](https://github.com/design-gurus/engineering-manager-interview/blob/main/cheat-sheets/ic-vs-manager.md): An individual contributor (IC) is an engineer who is measured on the work they produce themselves.
- [Questions to Ask the Interviewer](https://github.com/design-gurus/engineering-manager-interview/blob/main/cheat-sheets/questions-to-ask-the-interviewer.md): Most rounds end with five minutes for the candidate's questions.
- [Red Flags in an Engineering Manager Interview](https://github.com/design-gurus/engineering-manager-interview/blob/main/cheat-sheets/red-flags.md): A red flag is an answer pattern that makes an interviewer doubt the candidate, regardless of the rest of the answer.
- [STAR for Engineering Managers](https://github.com/design-gurus/engineering-manager-interview/blob/main/cheat-sheets/star-for-managers.md): STAR is a structure for answering questions about past experience.
- [The Story Bank](https://github.com/design-gurus/engineering-manager-interview/blob/main/cheat-sheets/story-bank.md): A story bank is a short list of real cases from your career, prepared in advance and mapped to the kinds of questions an interviewer asks.

## Questions

- [Behavioral Interview Questions for Engineering Managers](https://github.com/design-gurus/engineering-manager-interview/blob/main/questions/behavioral-questions.md): These 18 questions ask about the candidate's own past conduct.
- [People Management Interview Questions](https://github.com/design-gurus/engineering-manager-interview/blob/main/questions/people-management-questions.md): These 20 questions cover the seven subjects that people management rounds return to: low performers, firing, hiring, delegation, top performers, conflict, and diversity.
- [Project and Delivery Interview Questions](https://github.com/design-gurus/engineering-manager-interview/blob/main/questions/project-and-delivery-questions.md): These 18 questions cover how a manager plans, tracks, and delivers work through a team.
- [Situational Interview Questions for Engineering Managers](https://github.com/design-gurus/engineering-manager-interview/blob/main/questions/situational-questions.md): These 16 questions describe a hypothetical situation and ask what the candidate would do.

## Rounds

- [The Behavioral Round](https://github.com/design-gurus/engineering-manager-interview/blob/main/rounds/behavioral.md): A behavioral question asks about something the candidate actually did: "Tell me about a time when..." The round rests on one assumption, which is that past behavior predicts future behavior.
- [The Coding Round for Engineering Managers](https://github.com/design-gurus/engineering-manager-interview/blob/main/rounds/coding.md): Some companies ask engineering manager candidates to write code, and some do not.
- [The Engineering Manager Interview Loop](https://github.com/design-gurus/engineering-manager-interview/blob/main/rounds/interview-loop.md): An engineering manager loop has three stages: a recruiter screen, a hiring manager screen, and an onsite of four to six rounds.
- [The People Management Round](https://github.com/design-gurus/engineering-manager-interview/blob/main/rounds/people-management.md): The people management round asks how the candidate has handled decisions about individual people: a weak performer, a strong performer, a hire, a conflict.
- [The Project Retrospective Interview](https://github.com/design-gurus/engineering-manager-interview/blob/main/rounds/project-retrospective.md): A project retrospective interview is a round in which the candidate presents one past project and then defends its decisions under detailed questioning.
- [The Situational Round](https://github.com/design-gurus/engineering-manager-interview/blob/main/rounds/situational.md): A situational question describes a hypothetical situation and asks what the candidate would do: "Suppose your best engineer tells you she is leaving.
- [System Design for Engineering Managers](https://github.com/design-gurus/engineering-manager-interview/blob/main/rounds/system-design-for-managers.md): The system design round asks a manager to design a large system in 45 to 60 minutes, as it does for an engineer.
